cubes.name: order_lines_by_order_id
cubes.sql:
`SELECT order_id, ANY_VALUE(line_number) AS line_number, ANY_VALUE(product) AS product, ANY_VALUE(qty) AS qty, ANY_VALUE(line_total_eur) AS line_total_eur, ANY_VALUE(order_discount_eur) AS order_discount_eur, MAX(order_discount_eur) AS _order_discount
FROM bakery.order_lines
GROUP BY order_id`
